notes.truncated_chunks: The truncated_chunks values in dev were counted with the tokenizer's padding on, so every chunk in a batch was padded to the batch's longest and counted with it; they are not truncation counts. The corrected counts of chunks longer than 512 tokens (the model reads only the first 512) are in truncated_chunks_corrected, computed after the run on the same dev contracts and chunks with the pinned tokenizer, padding and truncation off. The counter is fixed in Embedder.truncated, so a new run writes correct counts and this note can then be removed.

rule: on the dev set, the chunk size (64, 128 or 256 words) with the highest mean of vector and keyword within-contract recall@3 (CUAD questions); ties go to the smaller size
